messages:
miriam: Heads up — we need a compact nurture for the upcoming 'Benchmark & Launch' webinar on Apr 14. Thinking a 3-email mini series + reminder. Primary goal: webinar signups -> product trial. Draft cadence below, need segment + CTA language.
jamal: Love it. Can we merge with the existing welcome drip for new signups so we don't double-send?
elena: Yes — suggested flow: Day 0 = launch invite, Day 3 = benchmark case study (short), Day 7 = webinar reminder + trial CTA. Add a VIP path for high-fit leads (>5k ARR or engaged in last 7d).
sasha: Proposed segmentation: inbound MQLs (eng), trial users (in-app), newsletter subs (eng + pm). For messaging we should do dev vs PM variants.
kevin: I'll own send windows and ESP config. Plan APAC stagger: send_window: Mon-Wed 09:00-12:00 PDT for NA, stagger +12h for APAC. Also confirm suppression list and throttle.
campaign-bot: Deploybot: email-template-v2 deployed at 1763141500 :white_check_mark:
miriam: Copy plan: short, technical variant for devs; higher-level narrative for PMs. Jamal — can you draft the dev copy? Sasha — PM copy? Also need 1-line social post for launch.
jamal: Yep, I'll draft dev copy and three subject options by EOD Fri.
elena: Tracking: create unique UTM per segment + tie to person_id in analytics. I'll add the tracking card to ops board.
sasha: Quick decision on success metric? Recommend primary = webinar RSVP rate, secondary = webinar->trial conversion. Proposed targets: RSVP >= 6%, webinar-to-trial CVR >= 3%.
miriam: Agree on KPIs. Also target unsubscribe < 0.5%. If CTR underperforms, swap subject and preheader on Send 2.
kevin: I'll set up A/B in ESP: 50/50 subject split on first send, winner rolled to remainder. Also add suppression for attendees of previous webinars.
jamal: Draft subject lines (dev): 1) "Ship LLM features with predictable inference" 2) "Cut inference latency — live demo" 3) "How we served 1000 req/s with <50ms p95"  — feedback?
elena: PM subject: "Cut inference costs 3x — live benchmark + demo" — love that. For dev subject, maybe punchier: "Lower latency, not your ops burden."
sasha: A/B plan: subject vs preheader for Send 1. Follow-ups use winner. CTA test: "Register" vs "See benchmark & try" on Send 2.
miriam: Action items: 1) Jamal — dev copy + 3 subjects (due Fri EOD). 2) Sasha — PM copy + A/B matrix. 3) Kevin — schedule send windows, set suppression, configure A/B. 4) Elena — tracking + UTM card. 5) I'll review copy Monday AM and lock templates.
kevin: Noted. I'll reserve send slots 4/12-4/14 and coordinate ESP throttles.
campaign-bot: Task created: #marketing-epics-2345 (email: benchmark-webinar).
miriam: :thumbsup: Thanks team — sync Monday 10:00 AM PT to finalize creative and timing.
